::: {.page-header}
# Open Source Geospatial Projects
Powerful, secure, and flexible — open source gives you the freedom to do geo your way.
:::

::: {.section-block}
::: {.content-container}

## Desktop Applications

::: {.grid style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(350px, 1fr)); gap: 1.5rem;"}

::: {.project-card}
#### QGIS
The leading open source desktop GIS. Create, edit, visualize, analyze, and publish geospatial information. QGIS is widely adopted across Indonesian government agencies, universities, and NGOs.

[Visit Project →](https://qgis.org)
:::

::: {.project-card}
#### GRASS GIS
Geographic Resources Analysis Support System. A powerful suite for geospatial data management, image processing, spatial modeling, and visualization with over 500 modules.

[Visit Project →](https://grass.osgeo.org)
:::

::: {.project-card}
#### gvSIG
A desktop GIS application designed for capturing, storing, handling, analyzing, and deploying geographic information. Available in Bahasa Indonesia.

[Visit Project →](http://www.gvsig.com)
:::

:::

## Geospatial Libraries

::: {.grid style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(350px, 1fr)); gap: 1.5rem;"}

::: {.project-card}
#### GDAL/OGR
The essential translator library for raster and vector geospatial data formats. Supports hundreds of formats and is the backbone of most geospatial software.

[Visit Project →](https://gdal.org)
:::

::: {.project-card}
#### GEOS
Geometry Engine Open Source. A C/C++ library for computational geometry with a focus on algorithms used in geographic information systems software.

[Visit Project →](https://libgeos.org)
:::

::: {.project-card}
#### PROJ
Cartographic projections and coordinate transformations library. Essential for working with Indonesia's various coordinate reference systems.

[Visit Project →](https://proj.org)
:::

:::

## Web Mapping

::: {.grid style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(350px, 1fr)); gap: 1.5rem;"}

::: {.project-card}
#### GeoServer
An open source server for sharing geospatial data. Designed for interoperability, it publishes data from any major spatial data source using open standards (WMS, WFS, WCS).

[Visit Project →](https://geoserver.org)
:::

::: {.project-card}
#### MapServer
A platform for publishing spatial data and interactive mapping applications to the web. Supports OGC standards and runs on all major operating systems.

[Visit Project →](https://mapserver.org)
:::

::: {.project-card}
#### OpenLayers
A high-performance, feature-packed JavaScript library for creating interactive maps on the web. Powers many Indonesian geoportal applications.

[Visit Project →](https://openlayers.org)
:::

::: {.project-card}
#### Leaflet
The leading open source JavaScript library for mobile-friendly interactive maps. Lightweight and perfect for web mapping applications.

[Visit Project →](https://leafletjs.com)
:::

:::

## Spatial Databases

::: {.grid style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(350px, 1fr)); gap: 1.5rem;"}

::: {.project-card}
#### PostGIS
Spatial database extender for PostgreSQL. Adds support for geographic objects allowing location queries to be run in SQL. The standard for enterprise geospatial data management.

[Visit Project →](https://postgis.net)
:::

::: {.project-card}
#### SpatiaLite
A spatial extension for SQLite. A lightweight, self-contained spatial database ideal for mobile and embedded applications.

[Visit Project →](https://www.gaia-gis.it/fossil/libspatialite)
:::

:::

## Content Management & Catalogs

::: {.grid style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(350px, 1fr)); gap: 1.5rem;"}

::: {.project-card}
#### GeoNode
A web-based platform for developing geospatial information systems and deploying spatial data infrastructures. Used by several Indonesian agencies for data sharing.

[Visit Project →](https://geonode.org)
:::

::: {.project-card}
#### GeoNetwork
A catalog application to manage spatially referenced resources. Provides metadata editing and search functions and supports OGC standards.

[Visit Project →](https://geonetwork-opensource.org)
:::

::: {.project-card}
#### pycsw
An OGC CSW server implementation written in Python. Enables publishing and discovery of geospatial metadata via OGC standards.

[Visit Project →](https://pycsw.org)
:::

:::

## Community Projects

::: {.grid style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(350px, 1fr)); gap: 1.5rem;"}

::: {.project-card}
#### OpenStreetMap
The free, editable map of the world. Indonesia is home to one of the most active OSM communities globally, with significant contributions to humanitarian mapping.

[Visit Project →](https://www.openstreetmap.org)
:::

::: {.project-card}
#### OSGeoLive
A self-contained bootable DVD/USB with pre-configured open source geospatial applications. Perfect for workshops and trying out geospatial software.

[Visit Project →](https://live.osgeo.org)
:::

:::
